environment.gpu: NVIDIA-SMI has failed because it couldn't communicate with the NVIDIA driver. Make sure that the latest NVIDIA driver is installed and running.

actions_requiring_approval: Use validated v8 for not-yet-started verification shards, preserving all running jobs.
Run the bounded repair pass on newly completed saved-label shards; at most one repair job, at most four total CPU submissions.
Allow downstream extraction only when all eight repaired shard manifests account for every planned attempt with zero unexplained discrepancies and the actual merge job completed with exit code zero.
Record every queue edit and original dependency list; preserve original source journals and failed job history.
automation_proposal.approval_review_rejection: The earlier attempt to install/start a persistent queue-mutating controller was rejected for broad long-lived operational changes. No such controller was installed or started.
stop_conditions: Any failed regression, manifest digest, missing attempt, unresolved disagreement, failed repair job, or unexpected existing gather output.

eta.assumptions: historical median seconds per independent Lean worker, 6-8 workers, upper multiplier 1.5; excludes unresolved new failures and queue waits
eta.full_tail_reason: pilot gates skip most expensive estimators; main double-bootstrap runtime not measured
eta.gpu_assumptions: linear extrapolation from 80-attempt pilots includes loading overhead; main length mix may differ; no queue wait
eta.kind: engineering scenarios, not confidence intervals or guarantees

io_benchmark.scope: one integrity-DAG benchmark; baseline ran first, cache warming can affect timing; no claim of equal whole-pipeline acceleration
